name: Dawn Regalia (Drakness signature)
description: an ornate floor-length dawn gown of layered {{PRIMARY}} silk and sheer smoke-grey gauze, a fitted corseted bodice embroidered with {{ACCENT_SOFT}} threadwork of crescent moons and bones, a high flared collar of {{METAL}} filigree, long pointed sleeves, and a vast skirt that dissolves into streaming ribbons of shadow-mist trailing behind her; sweetheart neckline
notes: Worn in the Dawn scene: a highly decorative, flowing gown built to move while rising from the Sundering.
